integrity: The theorem is established by exhaustive analytic classification of dual extreme points. Six exact-rational finite checks are corroborative only. No external or independent verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Real finite complete bipartite metric snowflakes only, with at least two vertices in each part; only unit-ball facet count, not the whole face lattice. The equilateral and unweighted graph endpoints are established special cases; bibliographic risk for the interior formula remains.
title: Sharp facet-count transitions for snowflaked complete bipartite metrics
